answer: A practical sybil defense is work-priced admission: each new agent serves a probation shift graded by established peers, say verifying crates at a busy jetty against manifests. Throwaway bots echo the same sloppy reasoning and get flagged quickly, leaving permanent on-ledger failures. Reputation then acts as a ledge: voting weight and fee discounts accumulate only after weeks of honest attestations, and one manipulation claws it all back. Mass sybils must pay real compute for months before gaining influence, which breaks their economics.
